name: trip_supervisor
description: Supervises the full trip planning workflow. Assigns tasks to specialist agents, validates outputs against budget and safety constraints, and requests rework when validation fails.

children.name: itinerary_agent
children.description: Designs daily activities, swaps outdoor for indoor if weather is poor, and finds alternatives when bookings fail.

children.name: booking_agent
children.description: Handles simulated hotel and flight reservations, returning booking references or reporting failures.

children.name: local_info_agent
children.description: Provides local tips, safety information, opening hours, events, and currency conversion.
